_help: People to follow closely. Use 'slug' (Tracefour insider slug, EDGAR order: surname-first) or 'query' (all words must appear in the filer's name; picks the person up automatically once they file a Form 4). Only public filings exist for these people: SEC Form 4s when they are an officer, director or 10% holder of a public company.

congress_family._help: Spouse and dependent-child trades from STOCK Act PTRs. House: every member, from the House Clerk, every run. Senate: all_members=true sweeps every senator via Tracefour at most once per day and needs TRACEFOUR_API_KEY.
